parse.wikitext:
'''Drumcorps Cat''' is a [[:Category:Rare Cats|Rare Cat]] that was added in [[Version 4.0 Update|Version 4.0]] and can be unlocked when beating the stage [[Black Hole Rising (Insane)|Dimension of Despair]] appearing every Thursday. [[True Form]] added in [[Version 8.2 Update|Version 8.2]] increases attack power and health, and gains [[Multi-Hit]]. {{Cat Info |ID = 201 |rarity = RR |name1 = Drumcorps Cat |name2 = Banner Cat |name3 = Mochi Cat |image1 = 201 1.png |image2 = 201 2.png |image3 = 201 3.png }} ==Evolution== Evolves into '''Banner Cat''' at level 10. Evolves into '''Mochi Cat''' when obtained from [[Revenge of Black Hole (Deadly)|Revenge of Black Hole]] (guaranteed to drop) and is level 20 or above. ==Strategy/Usage== This unit can weaken Metal enemies at a 40% chance to 50% attack power for a very long duration. Although not guaranteed, this weaken helps a lot for certain Metal enemies such as [[Sir Metal Seal]] or [[Metal One Horn]] due to their high DPS. Because of his Single Attack, he is not recommended to be used against [[Metal Doge]] or [[Croconator]] swarms. ==='''True Form'''=== It gains 20 more attack power, 3,000 more HP and [[Multi-Hit]], effectively raising his chance to weaken metallic foes to 64%.
